attr.title: RG808
attr.desc: A Roland TR-808 style drum machine: 16-step sequencer with 11 classic voices (BD, SD, toms, hats, clave, clap, cowbell, cymbal), per-step accents, sample-accurate timing and pattern save. Built with C and SDL2 for 640x480 handhelds.
attr.inst: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.
